title: Standardize four transparent export variants per brand asset
summary: Plan four transparent PNGs and four transparent SVGs for each approved logo, wordmark, and logo-plus-wordmark lockup. The proposed treatments are full color for light surfaces, full color for dark surfaces, solid black, and solid white. Count each approved standalone symbol or lockup independently.

origin.source: Project owner requested four PNG and four SVG variants for logo, wordmark, and combined artwork.

benefits: Gives adopters a predictable set of transparent exports for website themes and one-ink placements.
Keeps the same brand artwork recognizable across format and background changes.
risks: Color changes and raster scaling can alter contrast, spacing, or small-size legibility.
A new lockup or simplified icon adds its own export set and needs separate owner review.

evidence.claim: The released kit defines PNG inventory and export guidance. The proposed matrix adds a vector counterpart and a predictable set of treatments.
The released review workflow asks for small-size checks, one-color silhouette, light and dark placement, and the combined lockup.
